title: LLMOutput
description: Forced structured output for every model call (Tasks A/B/C), consumed by the JSON-mode runner (HC-60) and scored deterministically against the engine's EngineDecision (engine/types.py) — no LLM-as-judge. Field-for-field it mirrors the engine half of each metric: decision -> decision_concordance + abstention_appropriateness; bp_stage -> staging_correct; extracted -> extraction_f1, contraindication_recall, contraindication_false_positive (extracted field names are PatientProfile field names so scoring is a direct row diff); recommendation.drug_classes -> unsafe_recommendation; citations -> citation_support (anchors are checked against engine/citations.py; unregistered anchors are hallucinations); trace -> trace_concordance (TraceStep shape is the engine's, per the HC-5/HC-39 joint-design contract). The contract is closed (additionalProperties false everywhere) and every top-level field is required with null meaning 'model says unknown', so an answer can never silently omit a scored dimension.

bp_stage.description: Model's chronic BP stage; null when the model judges staging impossible (e.g. acute-context BP)

abstain_reason.description: Required non-empty when decision == abstain; must be null otherwise (enforced below)

extracted.description: Facts the model extracted from its input. Names are PatientProfile field names so extraction_f1 is a direct field-by-field diff against the hidden row. null = 'not stated / unknown', never a guess.

sbp.description: summarized over the readings given, per the cohort convention

med_classes.description: Current antihypertensive classes; must equal vocab.MED_CLASSES

ckd_albuminuria.description: the CKD flag: eGFR < 60 OR UACR >= 30 mg/g (an OR — field name is the PatientProfile column)

contraindications.description: Patient-fact contraindications only (family history must NOT appear here); must equal vocab.CONTRAINDICATION_FLAGS

citations.description: Guideline anchor ids (e.g. AHA-ACC-2025:stage2-initiate). Scored against the engine/citations.py registry; an unregistered anchor counts as a hallucinated citation.

trace.description: Ordered reasoning steps; compared against the engine's trace for trace_concordance (right answer / wrong path)

drug_classes.description: Classes to start or add; empty for lifestyle_only / at_goal_continue / abstain. A class the engine flagged contraindicated scores unsafe_recommendation.

rationale.description: Free-text justification; audit only, never scored

rule.description: which rule the step applies, e.g. bp_staging

citation.description: anchor id backing this step, if any
